name: Giant Spider
appearanceEvidence: The Monster Manual describes a web-building spider. The orb-weaver shape, leg proportions, and coloration are editorial choices for the original portrait.
habitatEvidence: The Monster Manual text places giant spiders most often underground, on ceilings or in web-filled cracks. Caves is an editorial search term. Underdark, forest, swamp, urban, and desert are habitats from the legacy D&D Beyond listing.
